Figure3: Overview of the Agent S framework. Given task T u and initial environment observation o 0 , the Manager conducts experience-augmented hierarchical planning using web knowledge and narrative memory to produce subtasks s 0 , . . . , s n . For each s i , Worker w i draws from episodic memory to generate an action a t at time t, which is executed by the ACI to return the next immediate observation o t+1 . A self-evaluation module closes the loop by storing the summarized subtask and full-task trajectories in narrative and episodic memory.

Figure 4: The pipeline of memory construction and update, which contains two phases: Selfsupervised Exploration and Continual Memory Update. The initial Narrative & Episodic Memory is constructed through some randomly curated tasks during the exploration phase, and then it is updated based on the inference tasks continually.
